message.content: {"hts_code": "8474.90.0000", "reason": "The imported unassembled components (steel hex drive shaft and backing plate) are parts of a machine tool for polishing/abrasive use and are not classified as finished articles, so they fall under parts of the Chapter 84 machinery heading 8474 subheading 8474.90 for parts of machines for treating mineral materials, though the backing pad is more precisely a part of hand-held power tools under heading 8467.99 and the assembly process does not alter the components' classification."}

predicted_reason: The imported unassembled components (steel hex drive shaft and backing plate) are parts of a machine tool for polishing/abrasive use and are not classified as finished articles, so they fall under parts of the Chapter 84 machinery heading 8474 subheading 8474.90 for parts of machines for treating mineral materials, though the backing pad is more precisely a part of hand-held power tools under heading 8467.99 and the assembly process does not alter the components' classification.
